fine_lines.title: direct speech vs reported speech
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلام المباشر ينقل الكلمات نفسها بين علامات تنصيص: She said, "Have fun." الكلام المنقول يحكي ما قيل بدون علامات تنصيص، غالبًا مع that، وقد تتغير الضمائر: She said that we should have fun.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Direct speech gives the exact words in quotation marks: She said, "Have fun." Reported speech tells what was said, often with that, and pronouns may change: She said that we should have fun.

She said that we need to show lots of cars.

fine_lines.title: smooth vs bumpy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: smooth = مستوٍ وسلس بلا مطبات. bumpy = مليء بالمطبات وغير مريح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Smooth = flat, with no bumps. Bumpy = full of bumps.

grammar.title: Reported speech
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نخبر عن كلام شخص آخر لدينا طريقتان: 1) الكلام المباشر: نكتب الكلمات نفسها بين علامات تنصيص: She said, "Have fun, Anna!" 2) الكلام المنقول: نحكي ما قاله بدون علامات تنصيص: She said (that) we should have fun. أجزاء الجملة: الفاعل (She) + فعل النقل (said / told) + that (يمكن حذفها) + الجملة المنقولة. نغيّر الضمائر حسب المتكلم: "You need to show cars" → She said that we need to show cars. ونقول said that... أو told + شخص + that...
grammar.explanation_en: There are two ways to tell what someone said: 1) Direct speech: the exact words in quotation marks: She said, "Have fun, Anna!" 2) Reported speech: tell what they said with no quotation marks: She said (that) we should have fun. Parts: subject + reporting verb (said / told) + that (optional) + the reported clause. Change pronouns as needed. Use said that... or told + person + that...
examples: She said that we need to show lots of cars.
Hank the Robot said that he has never seen anyone dance like me.
He said that I can't drive.
Penelope said she wants to go to lunch.

questions.question: Which is reported speech?
choices: She said that we should have fun.
questions.explanation_ar: الكلام المنقول بدون علامات تنصيص ومع that.
questions.explanation_en: Reported speech has no quotation marks and often uses that.

questions.question: Direct speech uses:
choices: the exact words in quotation marks
questions.explanation_ar: الكلام المباشر = الكلمات نفسها بين علامات تنصيص.
questions.explanation_en: Direct speech = exact words in quotation marks.

questions.question: Ms. Weaver: "You need to interview people." Anna tells Penelope: She said that ____ need to interview people.
questions.explanation_ar: you في كلام المديرة تعني آنا وبينيلوبي، فتقول آنا we.
questions.explanation_en: 'You' meant Anna and Penelope, so Anna says we.

questions.question: In 'She said that we need to show lots of cars,' the reporting verb is:
A road with no bumps is ____.
questions.explanation_en: Smooth means flat with no bumps.

questions.question: A hill that goes up very sharply is ____.
A short drive to try a car is a ____.
questions.explanation_en: A test drive is a short drive to try a car.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: He said me that I can't drive.
He told that I can't drive.
He told me that I can't drive.
He said to that I can't drive.
questions.explanation_ar: told + شخص + that، أما said فلا يأتي بعدها شخص مباشرة.
questions.explanation_en: Told + person + that; said is not followed directly by a person.
